title: Normalized evaluation at a linearly independent family is a unit orientation of its span (parent step 6c)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let b = (b_0, …, b_{m−1}) be a linearly independent family in ℝ^P, with Gram determinant Γ := det(⟨b_i, b_j⟩)_{i,j} (Matrix.det of Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (b i) (b j)). Then Γ > 0, and every ξ ∈ Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m) with ξ(α)·√Γ = α(b) for every m-covector α is a unit orientation of span{b_0, …, b_{m−1}} (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range b))).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → Euclid P), LinearIndependent ℝ b → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (b i) (b j)) ∧ ∀ ξ : MultiVector P m, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, ξ α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (b i) (b j))) = α b) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range b))
